evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: To address this problem, we propose MDSKILL, a multi-view distillation approach for skill memory internalization.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: MDSKILL organizes skill memories into three complementary functional views (state grounding, action planning, and execution control) and selects high-quality skills using dynamic metrics to construct view-specific and integrated reasoning branches.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate MDSKILL on three agent benchmarks against RL, skill-augmented, and self-distillation baselines that do not rely on stronger external teacher models.
